articles.title_zh: 视线语言模型向左和向右是哪里? Quen2.5-VL、Quen3-VL和InternVL3中的位置-代码反事实
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型可以从图象内容在补丁内的方向,其视觉变形器(ViT)位置代码,或其语言模型(LLM)中的符号位置和顺序中取出左向右方向. 缩写显示ViT代码是必要的;我们只通过镜像一个位置代码来测试是否足够. 在Quen2.5-VL-7B,Quen3-VL-4B和InternVL3-2B中,反射出VIT宽度位置复制了84.3-93.2%CV-Bench左后方问题上被翻转的图像答案(Quen2.5-VL-3B:87.5%,部分为左后倒). 有了两个选项,这也算作中断;半网格的转动也会翻转大多数答案. 由于ViT代码完好无损,LLM-side id和sord-order-servers镜像在所有三个系列中都改变很少左-右答案(Quen2.5-VL中一个弱的id测试). 在Quen2.5-VL-7B中,效果坐落在全局关注的Vit块中,多为后一. 在"What's Up"上,翻转内容和令牌顺序,而不是位置代码,在被翻转的图像解答时,比起左向右的答案,保持了更多的上下. 事后分析对这些结果作了限定。 在带有定位对象的 CV- Bench 项上,随机相接翻转18.9-31.0 倒转对象顺序时比保持对象顺序时多分. 在"What's Up"上,在Quen2.5-VL和Quen3-VL中,由随机地穿行而来,在镜像关系上登陆的左-右修改比例大多低于概率. 被算作回原答案,支持与左-右关系的What's Up对比只在InternVL3-2B中清晰可见. 大多数剩余的错误都给出了与所询问对象相同的关系,表明修补可以瞄准关联绑定,对象定位或使用参考对象.

articles.title: CURRENT: A Recurrent Neural Network for Concurrent Spatial and Temporal Super-Resolution of 4D Flow MRI
articles.content:
Objective: To improve the spatial and temporal resolution of aortic 4D flow MRI through a unified deep learning framework for post-acquisition super-resolution (SR) of reconstructed velocity vector fields.
  Methods: We propose CURRENT, a recurrent neural network that performs spatial and temporal SR with a single network architecture. Supervised training was conducted using paired low- and high-resolution datasets generated by embedding computational fluid dynamics simulations of aortic flow into in vivo thoracic MRI backgrounds, followed by controlled spatial and temporal downsampling. CURRENT was evaluated for two-fold spatial and temporal SR against 4DFlowNet and for two-fold spatiotemporal SR against sequential spatial and temporal SR pipelines based on 4DFlowNet. Image-based and k-space-based quantitative metrics were considered and conventional interpolation were used as baselines. In addition, the impact of CURRENT's spatiotemporal SR on physics-informed relative pressure estimation was assessed. Finally, the ability of CURRENT to generalize from synthetic training data to in vivo acquisitions was investigated.
  Results: CURRENT achieved superior spatial SR performance and comparable temporal SR performance to dedicated 4DFlowNet models while providing a unified solution for both tasks. Simultaneous spatiotemporal SR using CURRENT yielded more accurate relative pressure estimates than either spatial or temporal SR alone and outperformed sequential 4DFlowNet-based spatial and temporal SR approaches. Furthermore, the proposed model demonstrated promising generalization to in vivo 4D flow MRI data despite being trained exclusively on synthetic datasets.
  Conclusion: CURRENT provides a unified framework for spatial and temporal SR of 4D flow MRI. The proposed approach has the potential to enhance physics-based analysis and broaden the applicability of accelerated 4D flow MRI.

articles.title_zh: 现成:4D流磁共振空间和时空超分辨率经常神经网络
articles.content_zh:
目标: 通过一个统一的深层学习框架,提高主动脉冲4D流磁共振的空间和时间分辨率,用于重建速度矢量场的后购超分辨率(SR).
方法: 我们提出CURRENT,一个经常性的神经网络,以单一的网络架构进行空间和时间SR. 利用通过将主动脉冲流入活体胸腔磁共振背景的计算流体动态模拟所生成的对等低分辨率和高分辨率数据集进行了监督培训,随后进行了空间和时间下取样。 根据4DFlowNet,CURRENT的空间和时间SR为双倍,而根据4DFlowNet,CURRENT的空间和时间SR为双倍。 考虑了基于图像和以k为空间的定量计量,并将传统的插值作为基线。 此外,还评估了CURRENT的spatiotal SR对物理学知情相对压力估计的影响. 最后,还调查了CURENT从合成培训数据到活体采购的一般化能力。
结果:CURRENT在4DFlowNet专用模型上实现了优越的空间SR性能和可比较的时间SR性能,同时为这两个任务提供了统一的解决方案. 使用CURENT的同步瞬间SR得出的相对压力估计比仅空间或瞬间SR更准确,并超过了连续4DFlowNet基于空间和瞬间SR的方法。 此外,拟议的模型显示,尽管只接受合成数据集培训,但有望在活性能4D流动核磁共振数据中得到普遍应用。
结论:CurRENT为4D流核磁共振的空间和时间SR提供了一个统一的框架. 拟议方法有可能加强以物理为基础的分析并拓宽加速4D流磁共振的可应用性。

articles.title: Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
articles.content: Adversarial training is often plagued by "pseudo-attacks", perturbations that significantly increase the loss value but fail to truly alter the model's confidence structure. To address this, we propose two complementary approaches to directly attack and defend against confidence structure deformation. First, building upon the traditional loss maximization perspective, we introduce a hybrid objective that integrates cross-entropy and KL divergence, encouraging adversarial examples to simultaneously disrupt prediction accuracy and distribution consistency. Second, we geometrically reconstruct adversarial training by generating perturbations that maximize the distribution distance on the confidence manifold. Theoretical analysis shows that the optimal perturbation direction aligns with the principal eigenvectors of the Fisher information matrix. We also propose an efficient algorithm to avoid high-dimensional matrix computations. Experiments on multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that our method outperforms existing methods in adversarial robustness and robust transferability, particularly excelling in structural perturbations within high-confidence regions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过费舍尔几何进行结构上的信任干扰用于横向培训
articles.content_zh: 逆行训练经常被"pseudo-attacks"所困扰,扰动极大地提高了损失价值而未能真正地改变模型的信心结构. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了直接攻击和防御信任结构变形的两个补充办法。 首先,在传统损失最大化视角的基础上,我们引入了一个混合目标,将交叉内向和KL相差融合在一起,鼓励对抗性的例子同时破坏预测的准确性和分布一致性. 第二,我们几何式地重建对抗训练,产生扰动,使信心多面的分布距离最大化。 理论分析显示,最佳的扰动方向与费舍尔信息矩阵的主要编辑者一致. 我们还提出了一个高效的算法来避免高维矩阵计算. 对多套数据集和模型结构的实验表明,我们的方法在对抗力强和强力可转移性方面优于现有方法,特别是在高度自信区域的结构扰动方面。

articles.title: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
articles.content: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation using the same parameters. This removes the independent fake network while retaining S2-Avatar's frozen reference teacher, Self-Replay Forcing, and perceptual regularization. We evaluate APEX on 180-second videos using three backbone evaluations per block and a one-step spatial Refiner, with a 70-case human study and a 320-case StreamAV-Bench comparison. Compared with S2-Avatar, APEX achieves higher video instruction fulfillment on the Progressive track (3.856 versus 3.831) and higher visual aesthetics across both tracks (0.641898 versus 0.632606). Human raters favor APEX most strongly on instruction following, with +30.0% net preference, followed by consistency and video quality at +4.3% each. Motion quality favors S2-Avatar, audiovisual synchronization is predominantly tied, and usability is unchanged. Separate measurements under matched training settings show 4.4% lower peak allocated GPU memory per GPU and 9.2% shorter mean iteration time than DMD.

articles.title_zh: 以条件移动方式流出视频
articles.content_zh: 少步采样降低了流出视频制作的成本. 分布相匹配分解(DMD)以单独的假分数网络监督几步生成器,这增加了训练内存和计算,必须跟踪正在演变的生成器. 我们利用条件转移来估计生成的生成在生成器内的速度场,将APEX扩展为流媒体视频. 原始文本条件选择生成,而转出的条件使用相同的参数选择了假估计. 这在保留S2-Avatar被冷冻的参考老师"自重出击"(Self-Replay Forcing)和"知觉规范"的同时去掉了独立的假网络. 我们利用每块3个主干评价和1个分步空间提炼器,对180秒视频进行APEX评价,进行70个案例的人类研究和320个案例的StreatAV-Bench比较. 与S2-Avatar相比,APEX在进步轨道上实现了更高的视频指令(3.856对3.831),并实现了跨越两轨的更高的视觉美学(0.641898对0.632606). 人类评分者最倾向于APEX在接下来的指令上,其净偏好为+30.0%,其次是一致性和视频质量,每方为+4.3%。 运动质量偏好S2-Avatar,视听同步以捆绑为主,可用性不变. 在匹配的训练设置下单独测量显示,每个GPU分配的GPU内存的峰值较低4.4%,比DMD短9.2%的重复时间.

articles.title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match. On GPU kernel generation, AutoScaffold increases the fraction of tasks with a correct kernel that runs faster than the PyTorch reference by up to 5.0 points. On math, our student surpasses QuestA's reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps. Analyses show that the teacher identifies a different failure in each task class and shifts its scaffolds from step-by-step workflows to targeted fixes as the student improves, and that its revised scaffolds help the student learn more than keeping the previous scaffold or using no scaffold.

articles.title_zh: 自动脚手架:强化学习语言模型的AI-Guided脚手架
articles.content_zh: 以可核查奖励(RLVR)加强学习可产生丰富的培训经验,但成果奖励将每次尝试减少到一个数字并留下大部分这些信息被使用. 培训时间脚手架,如在培训期间添加到提示的策略或提示,提供了将这些信息转化为指导的自然方式,但其设计和适应性基本上留给人类,并适合特定领域. 我们引入了AutoScaffold,一个统一的AI-for-AI框架,将学生的训练经验转化为适应性脚手架,在训练期间只有最少的域特有信息,没有人类干预. 被冻结的教师定期检查这一经验,诊断出瓶颈,并以两种形式设计脚手架:(一) 在一个类别的任务中共享战略;和(二) 个别艰苦任务的提示,随着学生的学习,调整支持的内容和数量. 脚手架在评审时被删除. 我们对ALFWorld,基于搜索的QA,数学推理,以及GPU内核生成应用了相同的框架. 在没有脚手架的情况下进行评价时,接受自动脚手架培训的学生在所有四个领域都超过了接受相应RL基线培训的学生,获得的ALFWorld成功7.2分,平均QA精确比分4.0分. 在GPU内核生成上,AutoScaffold会将运行速度快于PyTorch参考数的正确内核任务分数增加至5.0分. 在数学方面,我们的学生使用大约三分之一的学生培训步骤,超过了QuestA报告的准确性. 分析显示,教师在每个任务班级中都识别出不同的失败,并随着学生的改善而将脚手架从分步工作流程转向定向固定,其修改后脚手架比保留之前的脚手架或使用没有脚手架更能帮助学生学习.

articles.title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
articles.content: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.

articles.title_zh: 矛盾发现:关于竞争解释的无端科学发现
articles.content_zh: 液压LM剂越来越多地用于无限制、由数据驱动的科学发现,但它们大多是按指针评价假设,测试一项经验性索赔,仅以美元为补充。 当证据拒绝支付美元时,代理商知道一种解释不太可能,但证据所支持的不是另一种解释。 为了恢复这一选择,我们引入了Contrastive Discovery,它用一个对照组合取代了单一的假设,一个科学问题与相互排斥和集体详尽无遗的相互竞争的解释相结合。 每个实验的得分是通过它的证据如何在全集中再分配信仰来得到的,当信仰集中在一个解释上时问题就会得到解决. 因为对比设定只改变代理建议和计分的单位,所以现有的代理可以使用它们来重新评价它已经收集的证据或指导其搜索. 在6个领域,有最大信仰转变的明智候选人中有89美元被否决。 根据同样的证据,对比之下,这些候选人中有73美元确定为特定替代品。 当对比设定指南搜索时,代理解决的问题比同一实验预算下的指针追加多67美元. 在一项盲目的研究中,38美元的人为78美元已解决的问题和82美元的问题选择了同样的解释,而尖端代理人拒绝其假设并停止了。 这些结果共同支持了明确的相互竞争的解释,作为发现物剂从同样的证据和验证预算中解决更科学问题的一种方法.

articles.title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
articles.content: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery, uncovering 24 novel failures with zero overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming. Our results demonstrate that (1) the information available to the evaluation harness determines evaluation quality, (2) functional and security evaluation are complementary, and (3) LLM-based evaluation harnesses surface subtle errors that human reviewers miss. We recommend a two-framework strategy: trace-based evaluation for functional assessment and adversarial red-teaming for security validation.

articles.title_zh: 物剂评价框架的比较分析:企业分析剂的稳定、检测和发现
articles.content_zh: 在企业环境中部署基于LLM的分析代理人需要评价框架,能够可靠地发现复杂多工具工作流程的故障。 我们对三个评价框架进行了分三个阶段的比较研究,每个框架代表一个不同的评价范式(基于追踪的LLM判断、仅以文字的LLM判断红色小组和确定性休眠),在使用被冻结的行刑痕迹的可控研究环境中适用于两个分析剂。 第1阶段通过反复测量将评价利用稳定性量化,发现97%的配置达到稳定性阈值,稳定性模式是独立于物剂的. 第2阶段衡量72起地面真实测试案件中已知的风险检测,其中基于微量的框架实现了最佳的精确-召回平衡(F1=0.90),而仅文本评价则与召回相吻合,但产生5x多虚假警报。 第3阶段评价未知风险发现,发现24个新故障,功能测试和安全红队零重叠. 我们的结果显示,(1) 可供评价利用的信息决定评价的质量,(2) 功能和安全评价是互补的,(3) 基于LLM的评价利用了人类审查人员忽略的表面微妙错误。 我们建议采取两个框架的战略:对职能评估进行跟踪评估,对安全进行对抗性红队鉴定。

articles.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference
articles.content: Neural networks are increasingly studied not merely as predictive systems, but as complex systems whose internal computations are themselves objects of scientific inquiry. Recent progress in mechanistic interpretability (MI) has made it possible to identify neurons, features, circuits, population structures, and dynamical patterns associated with model behavior. As these tools improve, attention is shifting from what can be observed inside a model to how those observations support mechanistic explanations. We examine the parallel efforts of neuroscience and MI to address this question and identify recurring inferential bottlenecks when inferring mechanisms from complex neural systems. We propose five principles and organize them into a recursive logic for a more rigorous procedure of mechanistic inference. These principles provide a framework that supports scientific discovery in two senses: it helps turn local interpretability findings into cumulative knowledge of mechanisms within models, and it makes those mechanisms sufficiently precise to generate testable hypotheses about domains beyond the models. Evidence beyond MI is ultimately required to establish what model mechanisms reveal about the world.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 机械解释 需要一个推理
articles.content_zh: 神经网络不仅被越来越多地研究为预测系统,而且被研究为复杂的系统,其内部计算本身就是科学调查的对象. 最近在机械解释性(MI)上的进展使得能够识别神经元,特征,电路,人口结构,以及与模型行为相关的动态规律. 随着这些工具的改进,注意力正在从一个模型内可观察到的东西转移到这些观测如何支持机械解释。 我们审查了神经科学和MI为解决这一问题而作的平行努力,并在从复杂的神经系统推断机制时,找出反复出现的暗示瓶颈。 我们提出五项原则,把它们组织成一种递归逻辑,以便更严格的机械推论程序。 这些原则提供了一个框架,从两个意义上支持科学发现:它有助于将局部可解释性发现转化为模型内机制的累积知识,并且使这些机制足够精确,可以产生模型外域的可验证假设. 归根结底,除了管理信息系统之外,还需要有其他证据,才能确定模式机制揭示出的世界。

articles.title: Pterodactyl: Pushing the Limits of Efficient Automated Translation Evaluation
articles.content: In this paper, we present 1020 Group's submission to the WMT26 shared task on automated quality evaluation. Our system, Pterodactyl, was engineered specifically for subtasks 2 and 3, that is, segment-level quality score prediction and the detection of error-free segments. Pterodactyl is a highly customizable, ultra-low cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. We also developed several variants of Pterodactyl that were specifically adapted for subtasks 3.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: P: 推动有效自动翻译评价的局限性
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了1020个小组向WMT26提出的自动化质量评价共同任务。 我们的系统Pterodactyl是专门为分任务2和3设计的,即分层质量分数预测和检测无出错分. Pterodactyl是一个高度自定义的,超低成本的系统,在翻译分类和数据校正中为二进制分类进行了优化. 它以LLM-as-a-judge方法为基础,在ROC分析的指导下进行即时工程和模型选择. 我们还开发出几种特地被改造为分任务3的变种.

articles.title: FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking
articles.content: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs. FERN (Feature-Engineered Ranking with No generative LLM) instead fuses three frozen retrievers into 100 candidates, describes each with up to 120 features, and reorders them with LightGBM rankers fitted once on BIRD's training questions. On Spider, where it was not fitted, its candidate pool alone reaches RASL's published recall at fifteen tables (98.0), and the ranker raises the share of questions with every gold table in the top five (complete@5) from 83.9% to 95.6%. At five tables, FERN's recall is within one point of RASL's on Spider (96.7 vs 97.0) and on BIRD with its evidence hints (96.6 vs 97.5), and 8.2 points below on BIRD without them (89.3). On 121 real BEAVER questions, without BEAVER fitting, its recall at fifteen (82.1) falls between two BEAVER-trained retrievers (80.8, 84.5), but its complete@15 is below both (49.6 vs 54.5 and 62.0). On Fiben, it falls far short at fifteen tables (54.2 vs 69.2, different question sets), although its recall at fifty is numerically close to RASL's question-only retrieval result (80.7 vs 79.4). On BIRD dev with evidence, non-retrieval features raise complete@5 by 7.7 points over retrieval signals alone. On BIRD dev, median latency is 208 ms per question on one A100, without hosted model calls.

articles.title_zh: FERN: 跨伯希马克表对 SQL 的文本检索, 并带有被冻结的 Retrievers 和 学到的分级
articles.content_zh: 文字到SQL系统在大型集合目录上必须首先取回表格中需要的问题。 我们比较了RASL公布的表格召回,该表格使用克洛德3.5模型提取关键词并选取表格,关于集合的BIRD,蜘蛛和Fiben目录. FERN(Feature-Engineered Ranking with no generalive LLM)取而代之,将3个被冻结的取回器装入100个入选者,描述每个入选者最多120个特征,并重新排列它们,在BIRD的训练题上安装过一次的LightGBM分级器. 在Spider上,没有安装它,其候选者池单在15个表(98.0个表)中达到RASL公布的召回,排名将前5个表(完成@5)中每个金表的提问比例从83.9%提高到95.6%. 在5个表格中,FERN的召回在RASL的"蜘蛛"(96.7 vs 97.0)和"BIRD"的1分之内,并附有其证据提示(96.6 vs 97.5),而下面的"BIRD"则有8.2分没有这些提示(89.3). 关于121个真正的BEAVER问题,没有BEAVER的合适性,15 (82.1)时的召回位于两个BEAVER训练有素的取回器之间(80.8,84.5),但其完整的"15"都低于两者(49.6对54.5和62.0)。 在Fiben上,在15个表格(54.2对69.2,不同的问题集)中它远远不够,尽管它在50分时的召回数字上接近RASL的只问检索结果(80.7对79.4). 在有证据的BIRD dev上,非检索功能仅通过检索信号就以7.7分提升完成@5. 在BIRD dev上,中位延迟为一A100上每题208ms,没有主机型号呼叫.

articles.title: When does text encoding matter for language modeling?
articles.content: UTF-8's role as the de facto encoding standard in language models introduces cross-lingual inequities due to its variable-length design. However, the effect that this encoding choice has on model performance remains largely unexamined. In this work, we investigate how text encoding impacts the performance of byte-level language models, comparing UTF-8 with a wide range of other encoding strategies, including other Unicode-based approaches, language-specific encodings, and our own customized encodings. To facilitate our analysis, we propose Aether: a hybrid encoding scheme that uses script-specific encodings for our target setting while maintaining full Unicode coverage through UTF-8 fallbacks, using this framework to model four orthographically diverse languages. Surprisingly, we find that while languages with information-dense characters (Chinese, Korean) significantly benefit from compressive encodings, languages whose characters carry less information individually (Georgian, Tamil) are largely insensitive to encoding choice. In light of these findings, we argue that text encoding should be a language-specific design decision, rather than a universal default.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 文字编码何时对语言建模很重要?.
articles.content_zh: UTF-8作为语言模型中事实上的编码标准,由于其可变长度设计,引入了跨语言的不平等. 然而,这种编码选择对模型性能的影响基本上仍未得到审查。 在这项工作中,我们调查了文本编码如何影响字节级语言模型的性能,将UTF-8与其他广泛的编码策略进行比较,包括其他以Unicode为基础的方法,语言特有编码,以及我们自己的定制编码. 为了方便我们的分析,我们提议了以太:一个混合编码方案,它使用脚本专用的编码来设定我们的目标,同时通过UTF-8回落来保持全Unicode覆盖,利用这个框架来模拟四种正文不同的语言. 令人惊讶的是,我们发现虽然具有信息密集字符(中文,韩文)的语言大大受益于压缩编码,但其字符携带的信息较少的个别语言(格鲁吉亚语,泰米尔语)对编码选择大多不敏感. 鉴于这些发现,我们主张文本编码应该是针对语言的具体设计决定,而不是普遍的默认.

articles.title: Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters
articles.content: Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. On clean audiobook speech (LibriSpeech test-clean), the median word is predicted correctly 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, while released streaming models get it 90 to 400 ms after it ends. Earlybird is the earliest on all six test sets we time, covering audiobooks, TED talks, public speech, earnings calls, and synthetic speech. On the same audiobooks, 69% of words are predicted correctly before they end, against 3-25% for the other models. For words still being spoken, confidence is calibrated, with an expected calibration error (ECE) of 3.7 to 5.5. On the eight English Open ASR Leaderboard sets, it is more accurate than Moonshine Tiny on every set and roughly ties Whistle, a model of the same size.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 早期鸟:29M参数中的预测流式语音识别
articles.content_zh: 流式语音识别器只在演讲者完成后输出出一个单词,一般是90-400 ms后. 对于一个语音代理每毫秒计数:单词越快被输出,代理可以越快开始搜索或计划其回复. 我们呈现出一个29M参数的流线识别器"早鸟"(Earlybird) (16.8 MB at 4 bits). 早期的鸟从随机点被切断的音频中学习,包括通过一个单词的分道扬镳,被要求预测到那时到期的每个单词,并加上对后两个单词的猜测. 其原始的象征可能性为每个词,包括仍在讲的词,提供了信心。 在干净的音频书语音(英语:LibriSpeech test-clean)上,中位词在扬声器完成前被正确预测为90 ms,而放出流线模型则在结束后得到90到400 ms. Earlybird是我们时间所有六个测试集中最早的, 包括音频书籍,TED演讲,公共演讲,收入呼吁,和合成演讲。 在同一本音频书上,69%的词在结束之前的预测是正确的,而其他模型的预测为3-25%. 对于仍在说话的词,信心被校正,预期校正错误(ECE)为3.7至5.5. 在英国八套公开ASR Lordboard上,它比"月光"(Moonshine Tiny)在每套节目上更准确,并且大致联系了同大小的模型"Whistle".

articles.title: Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
articles.content: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.

articles.title_zh: 位数还是相通? 将固定的推算预算用于加权精度或当地小语言模型平均选择顺序
articles.content_zh: 本地语言模型可以通过将权重存储到更少的比特中来保存内存,它们可以通过平均几回重排来降低对答案选项顺序的敏感性. 我们问,第一种做法是否使第二种做法更糟,而哪种做法更便宜地花费固定预算。 在Wen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B上,用模拟的圆至近重量化(8,6,4和3位,fp16参考)从ARC-Easy,ARC-Challenge,MMLU和HelaSwag上字母A至D的对数中读取,6位对fp16(它们得分+1.8 (+1.0至+2.5)和+0.9 (+0.3至+1.5)高分,我们对此没有解释),8位变化为-0.7 (-1.1至-0.3)和-0.4 (-0.7至-0.2)分. 在4比特下,答-slot skew从0.15起起至0.53起(0.6B起),从0.07起至0.12起(1.7B起);同分重量的高斯噪声SNR给出了0.15起和0.37起(两幅平分)和0.19起(一幅平分),因此对四舍五入是否添加了超过等能噪声的槽 skew的控制权没有定论. 翻转率上升,但低于独立统一出错的精确基准。 活化4个循环指令以0.6B(fp16为+5.3)的4位取出+12.6分. 我们用一个机器独立的单位来定价和通过, 重量字节读取次数通过。 在成本相配的配对中,额外订单仅在重量有6个或6个以上的配对时才会比额外位数,而决策表则缩小为: 使用6个位数的配对并花费预算的其余部分最多4个订单,每个订单一个通过. 每件事物都是用最简单的量子模拟出两个小模型;一个标题级的搜索发现没有更早的将量子化与选项顺序一起进行的研究.

articles.title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
articles.content: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 实际损失:优化分拣解码的实际预期接受时间
articles.content_zh: 光谱解码加速了LLM推论,方法是有一个模型草案,为目标模型提出多个符号,在一个通道中验证. 速度由预期的接受长度(EAL)来决定,然而标准的培训目标,如交叉接力,KL相差,总相差只注重分布匹配或单步相重叠. 最近的研究则提出了区块级培训目标,目的是直接优化ELA。 然而,这些目标仍然是替代的,而不是EL的确切表述. 例如,对于目标分配的续作,而不是被接受的代号所选择的核查分支,一些后来的平均接受率,引入了可倒向梯度方向的共变差距. 我们分析这一差距并得出REAL, 真正的EL培训损失, 使用路径权重进行无偏见的估计, 在与Qwen3.6-35B-A3B目标及多米诺起草器的可控损失级比较中,REAL的性能超过了WTV,VSD,DBLast,以及9个任务子集和5个评价种子的概率服务接受长度的静态LK基线. 这些收益仅要求改变培训损失,而不修改起草者结构或推论程序,以表明真正的EL培训的实用性。 实际损失的参考执行情况见https://github.com/King-ty/speclators/tree/real-loss。

articles.title: Blurring the Block Boundaries: Overlapping Block Denoising for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as effective alternatives to autoregressive models for latency-critical tasks, enabling faster token generation. Recent advances employ block diffusion with self-editing capabilities, where each block refines tokens iteratively before advancing to the next one. Yet each block is only as fast as its slowest token, and the next block cannot start before it. We suggest Blurring the Block Boundaries (B3), a novel method with which two blocks are refined in parallel within a shared forward pass. B3 calibrates itself on the fly, opening the next block only once the model is ready to start generating it. It is a training-free and hyperparameter-free acceleration method which seamlessly integrates within any self-editing block diffusion model. Evaluated on state-of-the-art DLMs across 10 diverse datasets spanning varied tasks and difficulty levels, B3 results in on par generation quality and 11.5-14.5% speedup compared to the base model, pushing the Pareto frontier for latency-quality trade-offs in DLM inference.

articles.title_zh: 模糊块边界 : 高效传播语言模型的重叠块
articles.content_zh: 扩散语言模型(DLMs)已经出现,作为耐久关键任务的自旋模型的有效替代品,使得能更快地生成符号. 最近的进展采用块扩散,具有自编自导的能力,每个块在向下块推进之前反复地完善符号. 然而,每个区块都只有它最慢的标志,下一个区块无法在它之前开始。 我们建议 模糊块边界(B3) 这是一种新颖的方法, 两个块在一个共享的前进通道中平行地完善。 B3在苍蝇上自我校正,只有在模型准备好开始生成后才能打开下个块. 它是一种无训练和无高参数加速方法,无缝地融入任何自编辑块扩散模型。 B3对涉及不同任务和难度水平的10个不同数据集的最新DLM进行了评估,结果与基准模型相比,生成质量不高,速度为11.5-14.5%,推动了帕雷托前沿在DLM推论中进行耐久质量取舍。

articles.title: ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents' Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces
articles.content: Research agents achieve increasingly strong benchmark scores, yet these scores do not necessarily translate into reliable delivery in ongoing research projects. Many research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone tasks and relatively self-contained workflows in clean or curated workspaces. However, researchers ask agents to complete one step within an ongoing project, where requests depend on earlier session decisions and workspaces contain unfinished files, outdated versions, and failed attempts. We introduce ARE-bench to evaluate whether research agents advance ongoing projects while respecting prior decisions and existing workspace state, grounded in real session context and in-progress workspaces. ARE-bench includes 75 tasks built on agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers' own projects, spanning seven research stages, 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total. Each task is anchored at a real user request, preserves its requirements, and summarizes the earlier requests still in effect as background. The complete workspace is replayed to that boundary without cleanup, preserving artifacts from earlier turns. Each checklist is compiled from an intent-aligned rubric and credits any valid solution. Across seven frontier models, the strongest passes every checklist item on only 66.2% of tasks, and Design and Execution rank among the hardest stages for every model. Three models pass about 69% of tasks when only delivery contracts and general norms are checked, but just 28.4% to 40.0% once historical and material or workspace requirements are also checked. Evaluating delivery without these contextual requirements can therefore overestimate research agents and mask differences between them.

articles.title_zh: ARE-bench:实时世界研究人员会议和工作空间研究能力基准
articles.content_zh: 研究人员的分数越来越高,但这些分数不一定转化为正在进行的研究项目的可靠交付。 许多研究代理基准都强调在清洁或整理的工作空间中独立的任务和相对自成一体的工作流程. 然而,研究人员要求代理人在进行中的项目中完成一步,其中请求取决于之前的会话决定,工作空间包含未完成的文件,过时的版本和失败的尝试. 我们采用ARE-bench来评价研究人员是否在尊重先前的决定和现有工作空间状态的同时推进进行中的项目,并基于实际会议背景和进行中的工作空间。 ARE-bench包括75项基于代理会议的任务和来自被招聘研究人员自己项目的全部工作空间,涉及7个研究阶段、33个要求和150个次级要求,共有1 173个二进制清单项目。 每项任务都是应真正的用户要求而确定的,保留了各项要求,并总结了以前提出的仍为有效的要求。 完整的工作空间在不进行清理的情况下被重放到该边界,从更早的转弯处保存出文物. 每份核对表均由意向对应标题汇编,并计入任何有效解决办法。 在7个前沿模型中,最强者仅通过66.2%的任务的每个清单项目,设计和执行是每个模型最困难的阶段之一。 三种模式在只检查交货合同和一般规范时通过约69%的任务,但一旦检查历史和材料或工作空间要求,只有28.4%至40.0%。 因此,在没有这些背景要求的情况下评价交付情况,可能会高估研究代理人并掩盖它们之间的差异。

articles.title: EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities
articles.content: Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host--device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer changes, while an auditor checks implementation completeness and drives iterative debugging through device-side validation. Across 12 tasks spanning three mobile LLMs and four engine--backend pairs on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, EngineAgent achieves 75% end-to-end success with either of two underlying LLMs, versus 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline. Success requires compilation, on-device execution, and output-logit agreement with reference implementations. EngineAgent also reduces average per-task time and model-API cost relative to baselines using the same underlying LLMs.

articles.title_zh: 引擎代理: 将 On-Device LLM 推论引擎与推论堆积分级意识和硬件特性进行代理化
articles.content_zh: 快速演变的LLM架构和多样的移动硬件使得支持基于设备推论引擎的新模型成为反复出现且成本高昂的系统挑战. 每个模型可能需要在转换、图表构建、操作员和硬件后端之间进行协调的改变。 现有的编码代理经常会错过这些跨层的依赖性,并努力在主机-设备执行路径中诊断出失败. 我们呈现的是引擎代理,一种用于在设备上自动化LLM模型的代理系统. 其关键见解是将可重复使用的引擎和硬件知识与模型特定实施相分离. 在启用前,EngineAgent会构建一个分级意识的引擎索引来捕捉引擎抽象层和跨层依赖性,并使用已经支持的模型预先验证后端特定构建,执行,并调试工作流程. 对于每个新模型,一个构建者利用这种知识来协调跨层变化,而审计师则通过设备侧面验证来检查执行完整性并驱动迭代调试. 在整个12项任务中,在CPU、GPU和NPU上跨越了3个移动LLM和4个引擎后端对,引擎代理公司以2个基础LLM中的任何1个都实现了75%的端到端成功,而最强编码代理基线则达到了33.3%。 成功需要汇编、现场执行和产出记录协议以及参考执行。 Engine Agent还使用相同的基础LLMs,相对基线而言,降低每个任务的平均时间和模型-API成本.

articles.title: AI Isn't Getting Dumber, We're Getting Pickier: Rising Standards in Human Evaluation of Large Language Models
articles.content: Users often complain that AI assistants such as ChatGPT are getting worse. Some versions do change, but human evaluation leaves a second possibility untested: the people judging may change. We separate the two on Chatbot Arena, a public platform where people compare answers from two anonymous large language models (LLMs) and pick the better one or say both are bad. We study 1,260,967 blind votes cast from May 2023 to August 2024 on pairs of models whose versions are fixed: dated vendor snapshots and models with fixed open weights. For the same pair of unchanged models, the share of votes saying "both are bad" rises by 1.71 percentage points a month on a mean of 17.1%, and by 1.91 points a month in 2024. In fourteen pairs observed often in both 2023 and 2024, it rose in every one, from 15.5% to 23.3%. The ranking does not trend: in 2024, the stronger model's share of decisive votes is flat. The rise holds within the same voter and on the same pair, and across arrival cohorts from their first recorded vote. It holds with prompt controls, in every major language, for dated vendor snapshots, open-weight models and models with stable answer length, and between interface changes. The drift is shared across models: month effects estimated from other models' pairs remove it from each model's own pairs. Platform-wide, the average model would be expected to score 78% against the 2023 average, yet the share of "both are bad" votes ended near where it began. The pattern fits a standard that follows the category's progress, so a product that stands still is judged as declining. Absolute verdicts on AI drifted while relative comparisons held steady, an evaluation drift that matters for LLM leaderboards and for the human feedback used to train models.

articles.title_zh: AI不是"Dumber","We're Gening Pickier:大语言模型人类评价中不断提高的标准"
articles.content_zh: 用户经常抱怨ChatGPT等AI助手越来越差. 有些版本确实有变化,但人类评价留下了第二个可能,没有经过检验:判断者可能会改变。 我们把两者分开 在Chatbot Arena, 一个公共平台 人们比较答案 与两个匿名大语言模型(LLMS), 我们研究从2023年5月至2024年8月对固定版本的一对模型投出1,260,967张盲票:日期标定的供应商快照和固定开放重量的模型. 对于同一对不变的模型,表示"两者都不好"的得票比例以17.1%的平均值每月上升1.71个百分点,而2024年则以1.91个百分点每月上升. 在2023年和2024年经常观测到的14对中,每对中都从15.5%上升到23.3%。 排名没有趋势:2024年,更强模式的决定性票数份额平平. 选民人数的增加是同一选民和同一对选民,是首次有记录的投票的到达组别。 它以每一种主要语言对过时的供应商快照、开放重量模型和答案长度稳定的模型以及界面变化之间进行迅速控制。 漂移是跨模型共享的:从其他模型的对子中估计的月效应从每个模型自己的对子中去除. 整个平台,平均模式预计比起2023年平均水平得分78%,然而"两者皆为差"的得分却接近其起步地结束. 模式符合跟随类别进展的标准,因此仍然站立着的产品被判断为正在下降. 对AI的绝对判断漂移而相对比较保持稳定,这种评价漂移对于LLM领导板和用于训练模型的人类反馈都很重要.

articles.title: Point-in-Time Encoders for Earnings Calls
articles.content: Text encoders turn earnings calls into vectors for search, for language models that answer from retrieved passages, and for forecasting models. A live retriever can use an encoder trained once on all available text, as finance retrievers are, but a backtest needs an encoder that read no text written after the date of each vector. To address this look-ahead bias, from 412,248 calls we train vintages under four pretraining recipes, with yearly cutoffs from 2010 to 2024, and each vintage reads only text dated on or before its cutoff. We then fine-tune each vintage on the question-answer pairs of the calls themselves. The vintages we train on calls alone, with 33.8M parameters, retrieve answers on held-out calls better than the general retrievers we tested in every test quarter. Their vectors also raise by about half the rank correlation between next-day returns and forecasts built from past returns and firm size. When each vintage continues the previous one, a later vintage retrieves better on earlier quarters than the vintage available at the time, and a point-in-time language model that answers from the passages the later vintage retrieves inherits the gain. The 2024 vintage of our families also forecasts earnings surprises better, although the interval of this gain includes zero on calls that no vintage read. It forecasts returns no better, so point-in-time vintages matter most for retrieval and little for forecasts of returns.

articles.title_zh: 收入呼叫的时点编码器
articles.content_zh: 文本编码器将收益调用转换为矢量搜索,从检索段落中解答的语言模型,以及预测模型. 活取回器可以像财务取回器一样,使用在所有可用文本上训练过一次的编码器,但是回取回器需要读取每个向量日期后未写出文本的编码器. 为了解决这种外观偏好,从412,248个电话到4个训练前的食谱,我们每年在2010年至2024年期间对葡萄酒进行培训,每个葡萄酒只读到其停产时或之前的文本。 然后,我们微调每个古董 在答题对 自己。 单凭我们所训练的调频器,有33.8M参数, 比每个测试区测试的普通调频器更能检索到被扣的调频器的答案。 它们的矢量还使下一天的返回与过去返回和坚固规模的预测之间的排名关联增加了大约一半。 当每个版本延续上一个版本时,后一个版本比当时可用的版本在更早的部位检索得更好,一个从后一个版本检索的段落中解答的点入语言模型继承了收益. 我们家庭的2024年历史也预示着收入会更惊人,尽管这一年收入的间隔包括不读任何年岁的电话上的零。 它预测回报不会更好,因此时间点值对于检索最为重要,对于预测回报则很少。

articles.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
articles.content: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks, where prior exposure to test material can obscure generalization. Moreover, real-world decision making often involves long contexts, large option spaces, and complex logical dependencies, challenges that existing benchmarks do not adequately capture together. Thus, we introduce MMDM (Massive Multitask Decision Making), a benchmark of 5,448 high-quality questions across 16 task categories, combining newly constructed tasks with source-grounded recompositions and rewrites for single-select, multi-select, and soft-label decision making in fresh contexts. It covers realistic scenarios such as agent state tracking, tool and skill selection, preference judgments, and rubric scoring, with option spaces ranging from 2 to 1,024 and inputs extending to 64,817 tokens. With MMDM, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative evaluation of 28 decision models, showing that many perform well on common knowledge yet struggle with interdependent options, constrained decisions, and multi-select tasks. For example, Perplexity Decider-V1.2 reaches 78.75% Hard Single-select Accuracy on world knowledge, but only 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning, while the best Hard Multi-select Accuracy across all models is 36.81%. These results highlight joint reasoning, constraint-aware selection, and complete multi-select recovery as key priorities for decision model development, with MMDM providing a testbed for measuring this progress.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MMDM:衡量大规模多任务决策
articles.content_zh: 系统1决定 模型直接在单个前传的状态下,对特定查询选项作出结构化概率决定,而不自动生成推理轨迹或文字回放. 最近的评价涉及各种任务,但往往依靠现有的基准,因为事先接触试验材料可能掩盖一般情况。 此外,现实世界的决策往往涉及较长的背景、很大的选择空间和复杂的逻辑依赖性,而现有的基准却无法充分抓住这些挑战。 因此,我们引入了MMDM(Massive Multiple Taking),这是跨16个任务类别5,448个高质量问题的基准,将新构建的任务与源头重构和重写结合起来,用于在新情况下进行单选,多选和软标签决策. 它涵盖现实情景,如代理状态跟踪、工具和技能选择、偏好判断和标分,选项空间从2到1 024,投入扩展至64 817个令牌。 与MMDM一起,我们对28个决策模式进行了全面的定量评价,表明许多决策模式在共同知识方面表现良好,但与相互依存的选择、受制约的决定和多选择的任务相抗衡。 例如,Perplexity Confer-V1.2在世界知识上达到了78.75%的硬性单选精确度,但在选项逻辑上只有53.95%,在约束性规划上只有47.95%,而在所有模型中最好的硬性多选精确度是36.81%. 这些结果突出了联合推理、制约意识选择和完整的多选择恢复是决策模式开发的关键优先事项,MMDM为衡量这一进展提供了一个测试床。

articles.title: Semantic Chains: From Reachable Facts to Justified Answers
articles.content: How can the facts that justify an answer be found from a question and presented as a sequence of connected statements? This paper models a context as a graph of logical facts and takes as given which expressions represent each fact. A parent fact can express a relation among its subfacts, and a preserving edge allows the content of a subfact to be recovered within a full representation of its parent. Suppose a root fact justifies the full answer and a path of preserving edges leads from that root to a fact that designates an object shared by the question and the answer. Under the conditions of the model, a search starting from the objects in the question reaches the root and covers every fact in the selected expansion. The root then admits a text that forms a single link connecting the question to the full answer and justifying it. For chains with several links, the paper gives a complete enumeration of candidate orders within the stated class and specifies when the link texts jointly preserve the justification and support every transition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语义链: 从可达到的事实到合理答案
articles.content_zh: 如何从一个问题中找到有理由回答的事实,并将其作为一系列相关发言提出? 本文将上下文模拟为逻辑事实的图表,并按给出的表示每个事实的表达方式进行. 母事实可以表达出子事实之间的关系,而保存的边缘允许子事实的内容在其母的充分代表范围内被回收. 假设一个根事实可以证明完整答案的合理性,保留边缘的路径从根到一个指定一个由问答共有的对象的事实. 在模型的条件下,从问题对象开始的搜索会到达根并覆盖所选扩展中的所有事实. 然后根会承认一个文本,它形成一个单一的链接,将问题与完整的答案联系起来,并证明它是合理的. 对于有多个链接的链条,本文完整地列举了所述类别中候选订单,并具体说明链接文本何时共同保留了理由和支持每个过渡。

articles.title: An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework
articles.content: We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). On 100 draft laws, the pipeline matches 0.28 of the findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model, 0.30 with Sonnet 5.5, and 0.43-0.46 across all flags (non-blind; the frozen blind baseline achieves 0.21, 95% CI 0.16-0.26). Across all runs, most misses occur on provisions that the system located but qualified as a different risk, and none of the 32 legal-collision findings was matched. On 21 acts held out from tuning, the pipeline outperforms a monolithic prompt containing the full methodology under the strict measure, though not under the lenient one, and Opus 5.5 adds nothing over Sonnet. The reported scores reflect agreement with model-extracted findings rated by an LLM judge whose two access routes agree on 73 of 74 labels, without human expert validation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一名大赦国际助理,负责根据TRACE框架使反腐败立法草案自动化
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍一位AI助理,负责根据反腐败知识工具中心结构使立法草案的反腐败专门知识自动化,旨在筛选腐败风险的法案:确定专家将批评和点出每项法案中的监管缺陷的条款。 管道结合了决定性的核心解析、模式指导的单一提供资格、基于规则的因素分配和外部人力监督。 为了评价该助理,我们根据乌克兰国家预防腐败局公布的结论建立了一个开放的基准,其中包括132个法律草案和474个示范结论。 系统旗同意一项结论,即它针对一个相容的规定,而LLM法官则将风险评为相同(严格)或部分相同(lenient). 在100项法律草案上,管道采用当地Gemma 4 31B型,0.30同Sonnet 5.5相匹配,并在所有旗帜上(非盲;被冻结的盲基线达到0.21分,95%CI 0.16-0.26分)匹配其前十旗内的调查结果的0.28分. 总体而言,大部分缺失发生在该系统确定但被定性为不同风险的规定上,32项法律-组织结论没有一项匹配。 在21起不调谐的事件中,输油管的性能超过了一个包含严格措施下的全部方法的单一的提示,尽管不是在宽大措施下,而Opus 5.5则没有在Sonnet之上添加任何内容。 报告的分数反映了与由LLM法官评分的模型取出的调查结果一致,该法官的两条访问路线商定74个标签中的73个,而未经人类专家验证。

articles.title: Dyship: Leveraging Acoustic Features For Speaker Relationship Classification From Dyadic Conversations
articles.content: We introduce DyShip, a framework for classifying speaker familiarity and kinship from dyadic conversations in the Seamless Interaction corpus. We compare five speech representations: spectrograms, MFCCs, self-supervised WavLM representations, x-vectors, and estimated articulatory movements. Spectral features perform best for familiarity classification, reaching an accuracy of 87.81%, while WavLM achieves the highest kinship accuracy of 85.17%. X-vectors and articulatory features yield weaker results on familiarity classifiaction, but shine for kinship classification, with an AUC of 0.909 for x-vectors. Most classifiers exceed previously reported human and audio language model scores on the same dataset. These findings highlight the potential of conventional acoustic features for relationship inference and motivate further investigation of the conversational cues captured by different representations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dyship:从Dyadic对话中调取议长关系分类的声学特征
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍了DyShip,这是一个框架,用于将演讲者熟悉程度和亲属关系从无缝互动体中的对话分类。 我们比较了五个语音表达法:分谱法,MFCC法,自我监督的WavLM表达法,x-vector法,以及估计的动脉运动. 光谱特征最能表现为熟悉分类,精度达到87.81%,而WavLM的亲和度最高为85.17%. X-活性与活性特征在熟悉分類上产生更弱的结果,但为亲缘分类而发光,X-活性为0.909的AUC. 大多数分类器都超过了以前报道的同一数据集的人语和音频语言模型得分. 这些结论突出了传统声学特征对关系推论的潜力,并促使人们进一步调查不同表述所抓住的对话提示.

articles.title: StaRSE: Compact Russian Sentence Embeddings with a Sign-Coded Static Encoder
articles.content: Transformer sentence encoders provide strong retrieval quality, but their inference cost becomes a bottleneck when embeddings must be produced on CPUs or refreshed frequently. We introduce StaRSE, a compact Russian static sentence encoder that removes Transformer inference at deployment time: token directions are stored as sign bits, token norms are stored separately, and sentences are encoded by mean pooling over norm-scaled sign directions. StaRSE is initialized from ruBERT-base, fine-tuned on Russian adjacent-sentence and task-shaped pairs, and post-trained with a contrastive stage that directly optimizes the sign-projected token table. On RuMTEB, StaRSE reaches a task mean of $51.16$, $7.98$ points above the strongest included static baseline. The packaged model occupies $11.3$ MiB and has a mean CPU latency of $0.08$ ms per sentence, compared with an estimated $55.7$ MiB 16-bit parameter footprint and $1.43$ ms mean CPU latency for the closest-quality contextual encoder. Ablations examine adjacent-sentence supervision, token norms, and direct sign-projected post-training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StaRSE: 紧凑的俄罗斯句子嵌入了符号编码的静态编码器
articles.content_zh: 变形器句子编码器提供了很强的取回质量,但其推论成本在必须被嵌入到CPU上或被频繁刷新时会成为一个瓶颈. 我们引入了StaRSE,一个紧凑的俄罗斯静态句子编码器,在部署时去除变形器推论:符号指向被存储为符号比特,符号规范被单独存储,句子被用"平均集合"来编码在规范的标分指向上. StaRSE从ruBERT-base开始初始化,在俄罗斯相邻的发音和任务形对上进行微调,后受训练阶段直接优化了所投放的标志表. 在RUMTEB,Starse达到51.16美元的任务平均值,比最强的固定基线高出7.98美元。 被包装的型号占用了11.3美元MiB,平均CPU的空闲时间为每句0.08美元,相较于估计的55.7美元MiB 16位参数脚印和1.43分指CPU对最上等上下文编码器的空闲时间. 监外执行检查相邻的监外执行,象征性规范,直接招牌预测后培训.

articles.title: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
articles.content: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在基于变形器的语言模型中分阶段和可解释的外部计算
articles.content_zh: 合成结构的可变性和模糊性是自然语言的基本方面,现代法学硕士必须学会熟练地处理。 之前的"死后"研究表明,经过充分训练的"变形人"确实近似地对诸如"出外"之类的克恩斯解析算法进行了分析,但是对于这个算法是如何实际学习的,在理论上几乎没有定论. 在这里,我们为解决这个问题迈出了第一步,研究了无上下文合成语法中的学习动态,其中可变剖出树地貌。 阶段性学习曲线是完全可以解释的,因为所有损失阶段(a)都可以从分析角度计算,而(b)可以明显地与隐藏的潜在树变量的表示相联,从而可以消除歧义并利用更广泛的背景信息。 通过探究表达方式,可以直观地看到在深度和训练中出现出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 这种计算组织让人想起现实世界的LLMs中的结论,在此重要的是适用于一个合成模型,它允许对数据统计进行全面的分析控制,从而为理论进步打开了大门.

articles.title: Breakdown of Autoregressive Multi-Step Reasoning Under Concentrated vs. Diffuse Attention Head Dropout
articles.content: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($Δ= -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($Δ= -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 注意力集中程度低的自动递减式多阶段原因与 Diffuse 注意头退学的分解
articles.content_zh: 在长时间的觉醒期间,哺乳动物新科网络经历了局部的短暂神经沉默时期,被称为"异态". 在这里,我们研究类似的瞬息万变的集中中断如何影响自旋性大语言模型(LLMs)的相继推理. 在两个8B模型(Qune3-8B和LLaMA-31-8B-Instruct)上,对GSM8K基准的250对衍生物进行了评估,我们对比了注意力罩与预算相匹配的分散即辍学的组合。 集中的暴发引起大量推理退化:在发端参数为$\mathcal{B}=0.10美元(将5.7美元左右的易碎头孔体积)时,Qune3-8B的精度从扩散噪声下的91.2美元下降到78.8美元(Δ=-12.4个百分点[pp],准确的McNemar $p = 5.5\tims 10^{-6}美元;LLaMA-3.1-8B-指令从84.0美元下降到76.8美元(Δ=-7.2pp,$p = 0.0198美元)。 反之,通过分级的五分位数匹配,将相同的累积预算统一分散到各代人之间,其退化程度大大减轻(Quen省为91.2美元,LLaMA省为84.0美元)。 在探索性因子分离中(一美元=100美元),单步退学密度与单行时间表抽取的急速下降有关(一美元为Quen,一美元为-0.0美元;一美元为-text{holm}=0.0425美元),而多键接续显示的复合趋势没有结果(一美元为-7.0美元;一美元为-text{holm}=0.1892美元)。 错误分析显示,Quen故障反映了格式化答复中的出处错误(有条件的准确度下降为11.4美元pp),而在LLaMA22.2美元中,不协调者损失没有最后的答案格式行(有条件的缺口缩小为5.0美元pp)。 这些调查结果表明,自转推理链特别容易受到集中的结构中断的影响,为变压器结构的容错性提供了经验基准.

articles.title: Representational Atoms in Neural Networks
articles.content: Understanding the internal representations of neural networks and characterizing their relationship with human conceptual structure are two critical questions for elucidating model mechanisms. The former reveals how learned knowledge is organized in internal representations, whereas the latter provides a basis for interpreting these representations through human conceptual structure. Here, we formally define fundamental representational units (FRUs) and establish two evaluation criteria: fidelity and stability. We further prove that threshold-activated sparse autoencoders (TSAEs) can identify FRUs with high fidelity and stability under appropriate conditions, and validate this result through large-scale experiments. Further analyses reveal that FRUs with higher stability exhibit greater monosemanticity and can be composed across layers to recover semantic organization corresponding to human conceptual structure. These results provide a unified framework for defining, evaluating and identifying FRUs in neural networks, and establish a foundation for characterizing the relationship between neural network representations and human conceptual structure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 神经网络中的代表性原子
articles.content_zh: 了解神经网络的内部表现并描述其与人的概念结构的关系是阐明模型机制的两个关键问题. 前者揭示了如何将学到的知识组织在内部表述中,而后者为通过人的概念结构来解释这些表述提供了依据。 在此,我们正式界定了基本代表单位,并制定了两项评价标准:忠诚和稳定。 我们进一步证明,阈值活化的稀有自编码器(TSAEs)能够在适当条件下识别具有高度忠诚和稳定性的FRU,并通过大规模实验验证这一结果. 进一步的分析表明,稳定性较高的排污单位表现出更大的单相抗性,可分层组成,以恢复与人类概念结构相适应的语义组织。 这些结果为在神经网络中定义、评价和识别FRU提供了一个统一的框架,并为描述神经网络表现和人类概念结构之间的关系奠定了基础。

articles.title: Visual Similarity in Adult Word Extension and Artificial Word Learning
articles.content: When two objects share a name, how much does their visual similarity explain, and what do the teaching examples add? First, we reanalyzed trial-level data from a large adult word-extension study (Lewis & Frank, 2018), computing each test image's distance to the examples shown in the space of a frozen self-supervised visual encoder (DINOv2). Distance was associated with extension (log odds -3.23 per standard deviation; 520 people), and an exploratory post hoc analysis suggested that this association persisted within the taught domain after controlling for taxonomic level and teaching condition. Example composition also mattered: after three examples, adults extended a word to 1.1% of superordinate items when the examples were subordinate and to 77.5% when they were superordinate. Second, in an artificial learner using the same encoder, words joining two categories were learned less accurately the farther apart the categories were (84.7%, 65.4%, and 53.0% naming accuracy for near, mid, and far pairs). The encoder's distances correlated with human similarity and confusability measures from three datasets (rho = .501-.795), but this representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict learner difficulty, and a second encoder trained on one child's experience reproduced the tier ordering but not the pair-level effect. The secondary human data were analyzed under an internal plan fixed before the confirmatory analyses (not externally preregistered). Visual similarity accounts for part of how generalization is organized in both systems, while the composition of examples contributes what the distance we used does not capture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 成人文字扩展和人工文字学习中的视觉相似性
articles.content_zh: 当两个对象共用一个名字时,他们的视觉相似性能解释多少,而教学例子又会增加什么? 首先,我们从一个大型的成人词扩展研究(Lewis & Frank, 2018)中重新分析出实验级别数据,计算出每个测试图像的距离到被冷冻自控视觉编码器(DINOv2)空间中显示的例子. 距离与扩展有关(逻辑概率-每标准偏差3.23;520人),一项探索性事后分析表明,在控制分类水平和教学条件之后,这种关联在教学领域继续存在。 实例构成也很重要:在三个实例之后,成年人在实例从属时将一个字扩展至1.1%的上位项目;在实例从属时将一个字扩展至77.5%. 其次,在一个使用同一编码器的人工学习者中,将两个类别合并起来的词学得不准确,而分类之间的差别更大(84.7%、65.4%和53.0%对近、中和远对的命名准确性)。 编码器的距离与三个数据集(rho = 501-795)的人类相似性和相容性测量值相关,但这种代表式的对接没有转化成人源距离预测学习者难度的确凿证据,第二个受过儿童经验培训的编码器复制了分级顺序,而不是对等效应. 根据确认分析前确定的一项内部计划对次级人类数据进行了分析(不是外部预先登记)。 视觉相似性是两个系统中的通论组织方式的一部分,而实例的构成则贡献了我们使用的距离不捕捉的内容.

articles.title: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
articles.content: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions:通过双Promped LoRA解码器在图像条件VLM中进行字符-水平的幻觉-扩展检测
articles.content_zh: 我们提出2026年SHROOM-visions的系统, 共同的任务是在图像条件化的视觉语言模型(VLM)反应中, 探测器以冷冻的Gemma-4-12B-it骨干为主干线,并配有可受训练的LORA适配器(约10.7M参数). 因为骨干是因果解码器,所以从一个答案的单份读取的隐藏状态不能处理后续的符号;因此,我们在一个即时重复候选人的答案,并从第二次出现时取出特征,使每个位置在一次非自发回回转中都有大致的双向上下文. 一个字符级定位器结合中间隐藏状态来预测幻觉概率,BIO边界,以及一个响应级的弃权分数,而单独的语言特异分类器则为每个被预测的跨度分配出五个幻觉类型中的一个. 在封闭测试集上,我们的系统达到了一个宏平均字符IoU为0.4404,比官方基准(0.1854)翻了一番以上,在IoU上排名第5-6,跨越了四种语言. 在英语调音分解上,受控调音符将一个增益归属于与LORA调音符相仿的重复回答(其被持有的增益更小并集中在幻觉解答上),它们表明探测器依赖于图像解答对接:将图像横跨实例将IoU推向了预测-无底或下方的每一种语言. 在同样Gemma-4-12B-it模型也生成答案的部署中,其基重可以被再用,使无法运行单独验证器的局部问答系统的方法切实可行.

articles.title: From Bias to Positionality: A critical grammar for Large Language Models
articles.content: Bias has become a default lens for understanding what machine learning systems do and how we should relate to them. Bias is at root a deviation from a standard; in decision making systems we can supply a standard from outside: a law, a protected attribute, a benchmark, a statistical property. However, even there, biased is often used as a shorthand, without stating what the position taken is - a silent ``relative to''. In a general use of language models, nothing supplies the standard: there is no decision to audit and no counterfactual output, so the shorthand fails. We argue that positionality -- the located, articulated, owned and contestable position from which anything is said -- is the better grammar for the question these models now force: who is speaking, from where? Against the vendors' answer of nowhere and the seductive possibility of everywhere, we argue that when a model is taken as-if speaking, it speaks from somewhere, and this means positionality can describe models, and the way they are believed beyond their warrant, even though they are not accountable speakers. A model's positionality is laminar -- laid down across corpus, tuning, system prompt, application and the live conversation. We separate three sets of factors: the positionality of a model's creators, the behaviour they intend for it, and the behaviour it enacts, and situate current work within this matrix. This lets us highlight what each stratum inherits from the one below, with ruptures and collapses where that inheritance is disavowed. We then return to where models speak from, and discuss the implications for how models are made, read and held accountable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从比亚斯到位置: 大语言模型的关键语法
articles.content_zh: 比亚斯已经成为了解机器学习系统做什么以及我们应该如何与它们联系起来的默认镜头. 偏见从根本上偏离了标准;在决策系统中,我们可以从外部提供标准:法律、受保护属性、基准、统计属性。 然而,即使在那里,偏见也常常被用作一种简写,而没有说明所采取的立场是沉默的“关系”。 在一般使用语言模型中,无一能提供标准:没有审计决定,也没有反事实输出,所以简称失败. 我们认为,定位性 -- -- 位置、表达、拥有和可争的立场 -- -- 是这些模式现在施加的问题的更好语法:谁在说话,从何而来? 我们反对销售商无处可去的回答和任何地方的诱惑性可能性,认为当一个模型被当做是说话的时候,它从某个地方说话,这意味着位置性可以描述模型,以及它们被超越授权书的方式,尽管它们不是负责任的演讲者. 一个模型的定位性是平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 我们分离出三组因素:一个模型的创造者的位置,他们打算为之做出的行为,以及它所颁布的行为,并将目前的作品放在这个矩阵中. 这让我们强调每个阶层从下面的阶层继承的遗产,如果遗产被剥夺,则这些遗产就会破裂和倒塌。 然后,我们回到模型从哪里说话,并讨论对模型的制作、阅读和问责的影响。

articles.title: HandsOnAid: Building and Evaluating an Offline First-Aid Assistant for Emergency Response Scenarios
articles.content: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.

articles.title_zh: HandsOnAid:为应急设想方案建设和评价离线急救助理
articles.content_zh: 如果附近没有电话信号和救护车,就可能发生紧急情况。 电话上的一个小语言模型在这种情况下可以有所帮助,但其建议需要安全和准确. 我们建造了HandsOnAid,一个4位的Gemma 2B模型在FirstAidQA数据集上与QLORA进行了微调,共5,550个急救问答对. 我们比较了7个配置,包括基座,4位和8位微调模型,以及带有长地板,安全门或检索的版本. 我们使用了41页的答题库 里面有医检参考书 遵循ANZCOR准则 和严格的0 -5分分号 12个安全标准 四位前沿LLM评委(GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3)盲分出每个答案,45个隐蔽控制用于检查判断可靠性. 微调后将平均分数从基数模型的+1.08提高到2.34. 最佳配置在5分中得分2.51分,这是有检索功能的微调4位模型. 一名医学专业人员还对整个基地的40个答案进行了盲目评价,4位微调,以及检索配置,分数与LLM评委的平均分数相似. 一项关键词审计发现,培训大纲中对ANZCOR准则若干细节的涵盖范围有限,这是标题所要求的,这表明培训数据中缺少信息可能是分数低的原因。 在一个有6个CPU线程而无网络连接的智能手机设备(Pixel 7 Pro)上,4位微调模型以6.86秒的速度出出第一个可显示文本,并在14.88秒平均回答超过10个问题.

articles.title: Thermodynamics of words
articles.content: We introduce the word thermalization hypothesis according to which in a literary work there are effective interactions between words that drive them to thermalization where their word frequency distribution is the same as for the phenomenon of Rayleigh-Jeans (RJ) thermalization and condensation. In this concept, the different words play a role of classical oscillators (particles) and their word frequencies, or related tokens, are analogous to certain filling factors over energy state levels. The thermalization process is characterized by the conservation of total system energy, or total number of words/tokens, and total probability norm, or total number of different words. We apply this approach to analyze 16 literary works, including Bible, complete works of Shakespeare, and data from American National Corpus. We show that for these cases the effective system energy is very low and thus there is the RJ condensation phenomenon with a big fraction of total probability concentrated at the lowest energy states corresponding to a big fraction of rare words appearing only once or twice in the whole text. Such a RJ condensation is observed for light propagation in multimode optical fibers and other physical systems. We relate the thermalization of words to the recently proposed wealth thermalization for households in world countries. The economy concepts of Lorenz and Pareto curves, and also Zipf curves, are applied to the word frequency distributions of the selected 16 cases and it is shown that the thermalization theory gives a strikingly good description of real data.

articles.title_zh: 文字的热力学
articles.content_zh: 我们提出"热化假说",根据这个假说,在文学作品中,词之间的有效相互作用促使它们实现热化,其词频分布与Rayleigh-Jeans(RJ)热化和收缩现象相同. 在这个概念中,不同的单词扮演了古典振荡器(粒子)的角色,而它们的单词频率,或相關的符號等都与某些填充因素相类似而高于能态水平. 热化过程的特点是保存系统能量总量,或单词/托词总量,和总概率规范,或不同单词总量. 我们采用这种方法来分析16部文学作品,包括"圣经",莎士比亚的完整作品,以及美国国家公司的数据. 我们显示,对于这些案例来说,有效的系统能量非常低,因此存在RJ收缩现象,总概率的一大部分集中在最低的能态上,相当于稀有词的一大分量只出现在了整个文本中一到两次. 这种RJ收缩在多模光纤和其他物理系统中用于光传播。 我们把文字的热化与最近提出的世界各国家庭的财富热化联系起来。 Lorenz和Pareto曲线的经济概念,以及Zipf曲线,被应用到所选取的16个案例的单词频率分布上,并且显示热化理论对真实数据给出了显著良好的描述.

articles.title: MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese
articles.content: Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss' kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 macro-F1 and are precision-oriented but recall-poor. The transformers reach 0.833 macro-F1 and accuracy (Wilson 95% CI for accuracy [0.77, 0.88]), a gap of roughly 16 points, while Base and Large are indistinguishable on the test set despite a 2.6x difference in training cost. We argue that the value of the resource lies less in its headline scores than in the auditability of its pipeline, and we state three limits that users must reckon with: the artificial class balance, whose effect on precision under realistic prevalence we quantify; the association between provenance and label, which the released source field makes measurable; and the selection bias induced by lexicon-guided sampling and automatic triage. The corpus, annotation guide, models and experimental scripts are publicly available.

articles.title_zh: MISO-BR:巴西葡萄牙语的Misogyny检测开口公司
articles.content_zh: Misogyny是最普遍的针对巴西用户的网上仇恨言论形式之一,然而,用巴西葡萄牙语提供的公开和可审计的资源仍然稀缺。 我们介绍MISO-BR, 由896种平衡的社交媒体文本组成的公开的、有记录的和版本的, 书目将从X取出词典和目标指南的刮取与从OLID-BR取出的物品结合起来,OLID-BR是一个大型语言模型分解阶段,其即时解码参数被发布,三位注释员根据书面指南进行人工注释。 通知人之间的可靠性在816件物品上达到Fleiss的0.788卡帕. 根据单一的固定协议,我们将四个古典分类器(多管和伯努利纳伊夫·贝耶斯、一线性SVM和一线性森林)与经过微调的BERTimbau Base和Lige进行比较。 古典模型集群介于0.651到0.676个宏-F1之间,具有精度导向但召回-差. 变压器达到0.833个宏-F1和精度(Wilson 95% CI的精度为[0.77,0.88]),相差约16分,而Base and Large虽然在培训成本上存在2.6x相差,但在测试集上却无法区分. 我们辩称,资源的价值与其说在于其头条分数,不如说在于其管道的可审计性。 我们指出,用户必须考虑三个限制:人为的类别平衡,我们在现实流行情况下对精确性的影响;来源和标签之间的联系,释放源域使这种联系可以衡量;以及由词汇指导的抽样和自动分类引起的选择偏差。 教程、注释指南、模型和实验脚本均可公开查阅。
